name: @lynx-showcase/opencv-document-scanner
description: Cross-platform OpenCV document scanner for Lynx N-API AutoLink

scripts.build:lynxtron: cmake -S lynxtron -B lynxtron/build -DCMAKE_BUILD_TYPE=Release "-DOpenCV_DIR=$OpenCV_DIR" "-DLYNX_LIBRARY_HEADERS_DIR=$LYNX_LIBRARY_HEADERS_DIR" "-DLYNX_WEAK_NODE_API_ROOT=$LYNX_WEAK_NODE_API_ROOT" && cmake --build lynxtron/build --config Release
